=====PAGE=====

As you use the Find a provider tool, you can add providers you're interested in
to your shortlist. On this page, you'll find any shortlisted aged care homes and
help at home providers you're interested in exploring further. From here you
can compare providers side by side to see which one best suits your needs
and preferences. You can remove any providers you no longer need by
selecting 'Edit'.

Share your aged care homes shortlist
Want to share this list with a friend, family member or client? You can
email your shortlist and they'll get immediate access to view it exactly as
you've organised it. They don't need an account to see what you've
shared.
Looking for different providers to suit your needs?
You can use the Find a provider tool to search again and add more providers
to your shortlist at any time.
